Description: The table "0401230100_BCN_Nomenclator.csv" documents a list of streets, plazas, and other public spaces in Barcelona, detailing their unique codes, types, names, approval dates, alternative names, and descriptions, including historical context and notable figures or landmarks they are associated with.

The table "aac_intakes.csv" records data about various animals at an Austin animal center, detailing their identification information, type, breed, color, age at intake, and sex, along with their intake details such as name, condition upon intake, method of intake, location found, and relevant timestamps.

The table "aac_intakes_outcomes.csv" details the records of animal intakes and outcomes in a shelter, including information such as the animal's age, type, breed, color, intake and outcome dates, outcome types and subtypes, location found, conditions upon intake, and the duration of stay in the shelter.

The table "aac_outcomes.csv" contains detailed records of animal outcomes from a shelter, with each entry documenting individual animals identified by their IDs, including their type (such as cat, dog, or other), breed, color, date of birth, and age at the time of the outcome; it also details the date and time of the outcome event, the outcome subtype, type, and sex of the animal upon outcome, with additional information about the animals' names where available, illustrating the specific circumstances under which the animals were either transferred, adopted, returned to their owner, euthanized, or acquired another disposition.

The "abandoned-water-mains.csv" table contains information about abandoned water mains, detailing their diameters in millimeters, the date they were installed, the material they are made of, and their geographical coordinates represented in a "LineString" format.

The table "AboutIsis.csv" contains data related to tweets about ISIS, including information on the tweet author's name and username, the unique tweet ID, the time the tweet was made, and the tweet content itself.

The table "Accidental_Drug_Related_Deaths_2012-2018.csv" contains detailed information on accidental drug-related deaths that occurred between 2012 and 2018, including individual demographics such as age, sex, and race; locations associated with the deceased's residence, death, and injury; substances involved in the death; and manner of death, all identified by unique IDs and geolocations for death, residence, and injury cities.

The table "agri-environmental-indicators-emissions-by-sector.csv" provides data on emissions by sector for various countries and regions, spanning different years and types of emissions, such as CO2, CH4, and N2O, expressed in gigagrams or percentage shares, with an emphasis on the impact of agriculture, energy, waste, and industrial processes on total emissions with or without land use considerations.

The table "AguaH.csv" captures monthly water usage data from January 2009 to December 2015 for various residential and social domestic water use categories, identified by their types and meters, including specific usage rates or measures over different months and years.

The table "animal-control-inventory-register.csv" contains detailed records of animals under the care of an animal control facility, including information such as control officer ID, dates related to shots and impoundment, the animal's sex, receipt and pit numbers, name, kennel number, disposition details, color, breed, approximate weight, unique animal ID, age category, source of impounding (e.g., holding stray, complaint, police emergency), and current status such as sold, redeemed, or ride home free.

The table "chat.csv" captures in-game chat interactions for a specific match identified by "match_id," documenting each message's "key," "slot" position, "time" of occurrence, and the corresponding "unit" or player involved.

The table "district-wise-rainfall-data-for-india-2014.csv" contains monthly rainfall data for various districts in India from the year 2008 to 2018, detailing the specific district and state identifiers, their geographic regions, and the measured values, which include either the rainfall in millimeters or the percentage departures of rainfall from normal, enriched with explanatory notes.

The table "emissions_agriculture_energy_e_all_data_norm.csv" records data on emissions and implied emission factors related to fuel oil used in fisheries within Angola from various years, detailing different types of emissions such as those from CH4, N2O, and CO2, expressed in units of gigagrams or kilograms per terajoule.

The table provides a comprehensive analysis of energy usage in different community areas of Chicago in 2010, detailing the monthly and total electricity and gas consumption (in KWH and Therms respectively) for various building types and subtypes identified by census block, including additional data on electricity and gas account numbers, occupied units, building characteristics such as average stories, age, and the size of the buildings, as well as demographic information such as total population, occupied units percentage, and renter-occupied housing statistics.

The table represents detailed information about various religious organizations, civic groups, associations, and clubs, including their unique employer identification numbers (EIN), names, and locations such as street addresses, cities, states, and ZIP codes; additional attributes include their group and subsection codes, affiliations, classifications, asset amounts, income and revenue amounts alongside various other tax-related details.

The table "episodes.csv" contains information about various episodes from different radio programs, specifically detailing the unique ID of each episode, the program it belongs to, the title of the episode, and the date it aired.

The table "global-greenhouse-gas-emissions.csv" provides a dataset that details the emissions of the greenhouse gas nitrous oxide (N2O) from various sectors in Congo, categorized by year, world region, ISO country code, the sector responsible for the emissions described by the IPCC description, annex status, and specific IPCC category codes, along with the emission values measured in gigagrams (Gg).

The table "global-greenhouse-gas-emissions0.csv" records global greenhouse gas emissions, specifically the emissions of various compounds like CO2_org_short-cycle_C and N2O, across different countries and regions, including years of measurement, the ISO code of each country or region, classification by IPCC Annex categories, and emission values in Gg (gigagrams).

The "global-innovation-index-2015.csv" table provides annual data on various innovation-related indicators across multiple countries, detailing the performance of these countries in relation to different aspects of innovation such as technology exports, education enrolments, creative goods exports, and research and development expenditures among others, measured by specific indicator IDs, indicator names, and units, across different years and regions.

The table 'index.csv' contains unique identifiers and corresponding URL links, representing a dataset where each 'id' uniquely maps to a 'url' that typically points to image resources hosted on servers like Google Photos or Panoramio, with some entries lacking an associated URL.

The table "india-census-data-2011-census-primary-abstract.csv" provides detailed demographic and socio-economic data from the 2011 Census of India, segmented by districts such as Dimapur, Phek, and Tuensang in the state of Nagaland, including annual population statistics differentiated by rural and urban areas, with figures for total and various working populations categorized by gender, as well as specific data on scheduled castes and tribes, capturing diverse aspects of regional population dynamics and residence characteristics.

The table "india-census-data-2011-census-primary-abstract.csv" contains census data from India for the year 2011 which is recorded annually, providing detailed demographic and socioeconomic information for various districts and states including district and state identification codes, location names, and region identifiers, with specific data insights on population classifications such as total, rural, and urban populations, total literate and illiterate individuals, age-specific data, and workers categorized by their primary work type and marginal work conditions, all structured by variable identifiers.

The table "IPODataFull.csv" is a comprehensive dataset containing extensive information about various companies that have gone public, detailing aspects such as their performance relative to the S&P 500, profitability, stock values for over 250 days, IPO-related details like CEO and president particulars, industry associations, and financial data both after and before the IPO for up to 256 days, along with categorization based on factors such as founding date, CEO and President demographics, the financial performance of the year before the IPO, and market trends over multiple time scales.

The table "IsisFanboy.csv" contains information on tweets posted by specific users who appear to support extremist ideologies, including details such as the name and username of the account, a unique tweet ID, the time the tweet was posted, and the content of the tweets themselves.

The table "issued-building-permits.csv" contains detailed records of building permits issued in Vancouver, including information such as the permit number, issue date, project value, type of work (such as demolition, addition/alteration, or new building), address, project description, as well as details about the building contractor and applicant, their respective addresses, the property's use and specific use category, for the year 2019, with a unique BI_ID for each entry.

The table "JEOPARDY_CSV.csv" compiles detailed information about episodes of the quiz show "Jeopardy!", documenting aspects such as the show number and air date, the game round (e.g., Jeopardy! or Double Jeopardy!), category of questions, their monetary value, the questions posed, and their corresponding answers.

The table "listings_detailed.csv" contains an extensive dataset of Airbnb listings, detailing attributes such as listing identifiers, URLs, scraping details, descriptive titles, summaries, spaces, and full descriptions, alongside host information like host ID, response rates, and verification status, as well as property details including location, pricing, amenities, availability, reviews, guest requirements, and cancellation policies.

The "listings_summary.csv" table provides comprehensive data on Airbnb listings, including detailed descriptions, locations, and pricing information, along with host details such as host ID and response rate, and additional features like house rules, amenities, and neighborhood overviews for listings primarily located in Berlin, Germany.

The table "makemytrip_com-travel_sample.csv" contains detailed information about various hotel properties across different cities in India, including attributes such as location (area, city, country), star rating, the type of property, amenities offered, hotel overview, room types, reviews and ratings from different platforms, crawl and query timestamps, and unique identifiers, as well as emphasis on facilities available at the hotels like airport transfer, Wi-Fi, and in-room amenities.

This table, "medium_data.csv," contains information about Medium articles, including their unique ID, URL, title, subtitle, associated image, number of claps and responses, reading time, publication source, and the publication date.

The table named "oxford-covid-19-government-response-tracker.csv" records various government responses to the COVID-19 pandemic across different countries on specific dates, including indicators such as the Containment Health Index, Stringency Index, and international travel controls, and their corresponding values.

The players.csv table contains information about a list of players, comprising their unique IDs, image links that presumably relate to their avatars or profiles on the Nintendo platform, national flags indicating the country associated with each player, and their names, which include a mix of different languages and character scripts.

The table "population-estimates-and-projections-1960-2050.csv" contains annual data on demographic population percentages and counts for various age groups, genders, and countries, including Bahrain and Argentina, over different years, detailing the proportion of specific age brackets within the total or respective gender populations in percentage terms, as well as absolute numbers for certain age-specific groups.

The "posts.csv" table contains detailed information about various blog posts including the post ID, title, blogger's name and ID, number of comments, content of the blogs, their respective URLs, posting dates, number of retrieved links and comments, word counts and averages (including exclusion of stopwords), along with two specific scoring metrics (meibi and meibix scores) that potentially measure the quality or impact of the posts.

The table "property-addresses.csv" contains information about various properties, including details such as the civic number, geographic local area, geometric location as a point with coordinates, parcel ID, coordinates, site ID, and standard street name for each listed property.

The table "provisional-2016-bi-annual-aquatic-and-terrestrial-monitoring-results-26062017-raw-results" records data from a 2016 environmental monitoring program detailing the results of aquatic and terrestrial samples collected from various sites, which include information about the location, type of sample (such as crops or animal tissues), date collected, laboratory analysis, radionuclide detected (e.g., U-235, PU-239+240), and corresponding radioactivity measurements, errors, and unit corrections.

The table "Red_Light_Camera_Violations.csv" provides information on red light camera violations at various intersections, including the intersection name, camera ID, address, date of violation, number of violations, and geographical coordinates, although the latter are not recorded in the sample data shown.

The table, named "saudi-arabia-population-by-administrative-region-nationality-and-sex.csv," provides data on the population of Saudi Arabia from various administrative regions, segmented by gender, across different years, along with geographical information like shape and point coordinates specific to those regions.

The table "saudi-arabia-world-development-indicators-1960-2014.csv" provides an annual summary of various socio-economic and environmental development indicators for different countries, particularly focusing on metrics such as imports, exports, manufacturing value, population data, aid flows, and environmental statistics along with their respective aggregation methods and unit measures for the year 1968.

The "sewer-catch-basins.csv" table contains data on the locations of catch basins within different geo local areas, represented by their approximate positions in geographical coordinates, and primarily labeled as "Catch Basin (location approximate)."

The table "sewer-manholes.csv" provides detailed information about sewer manholes, listing their cover elevation in meters, the type of manhole (Sanitary, Storm, or Combined), their geographical coordinates, and the local area in which they are located.
The table "shortjokes.csv" contains a collection of short jokes, where each joke is tagged with a unique ID, sharing light-hearted, humorous content across various themes and styles.

The table "total-and-urban-population-annual-1950-2050.csv" captures the annual total and urban population statistics of various countries, specifically focusing on the Philippines (PH) and Poland (PL), providing data points such as the urban population as a percentage of the total population and the total population count in thousands over the years 1950 to 2050, along with identifiers and notes for location and variables.

The "water-control-valves.csv" table provides detailed information about water control valves, including their subsystem classification, size, operational status (open or closed), geographic coordinates and offsets relative to a property line in both x and y directions, directional orientation for these offsets, and their corresponding geographic local area.

The table "water-distribution-mains.csv" provides detailed information about water distribution pipelines, including their geographical data in the form of line strings captured under the column "Geom", the diameter of each main in millimeters, the date each main was installed, the type of lining material used, and the core material of the pipes themselves.

The table "water-hydrants.csv" contains detailed information about various water hydrants, including their identifiers, locations, types, and status, specifically in areas like West Point Grey and Dunbar-Southlands, detailing technical specifications such as distance from corners, feeder length, direction, line color, communication status, installation dates, and compression capabilities, as well as historical data on modifications and geographic coordinates.

The table "world-power-plants-list.csv" provides detailed information about various power plants worldwide, including attributes such as URL, name, design capacity in megawatts, geographical location (country, state, and exact coordinates), operational status, efficiency ratings, fuel types, environmental impact ratings, ownership, and operational details, among other technical and administrative properties.
